text:
Alex K: Quick sync — need clarity on forking rights + SKU mapping for open model partners before next marketplace push. cc @Jordan (Partner Ops)
Jordan (Partner Ops): Thanks. Short list: licensing (can partners fork & rehost?), redistribution SKU naming, and export vetting. Can we decide today? :eyes:
Ben (Legal): High-level: permissive licenses (Apache/BSD) allow forks; GPL-family imposes copyleft. For marketplace redistribution we need explicit consent from supplier for rehosting and commercial redistribution. Also export controls differ by region. We should avoid ad-hoc approvals.
Marta L: Agreed. From product/ops — we need a deterministic SKU scheme so listings and metrics don't explode. Proposed pattern: "vendor.model[-quant][-opt]-region" e.g., `sundial-13b-q4-ec2-us-west-2`.
Priya: +1 on SKU pattern. Also want a provenance badge in UI for models that were forked vs upstream. UX: show "Upstream: <name> / Forked: <partner>" and a link to license text.
Alex K: Ben — can we get a short clause we can add to the partner onboarding that covers: permission to rehost, attribution requirement, no sublicensing to downstream marketplaces, and export pre-checks?
Ben (Legal): Draft clause (starter, needs review):
```
Supplier grants Redwood a non-exclusive right to rehost and distribute the Model via Redwood's marketplace and private deployments, provided that: (a) Redwood displays supplier attribution and provenance metadata; (b) any downstream redistribution by a Marketplace buyer must preserve attribution and include a copy of the Model license; (c) Supplier retains copyright; and (d) Redwood will perform export jurisdiction checks and may block distribution where required.
```
Ben (Legal): Note: if supplier wants to allow unrestricted sublicensing we need a separate addendum and indemnity language.
Jordan (Partner Ops): That clause looks good as a baseline. Ops question — are we comfortable blocking listings by region automatically based on export vetting? Marketplace Bot: Deploy policy: auto-block flagged regions for models with export flags, notify partner and ops channel. :robot_face:
Marta L: Operationally yes, but need partner notification SLA (e.g., 48h to provide additional docs). We should also surface the blocked regions in the partner dashboard.
Priya: Regarding forking: product suggests two listing types: "Canonical" (upstream-maintained) and "Forked" (partner-maintained). Forked gets a separate SKU but links to canonical. Search should de-duplicate by default.
Alex K: Good. Let's also define metadata keys we require on onboarding: `upstream_name`, `upstream_license`, `fork_owner`, `quantization_profile`, `export_flags`.
Jordan (Partner Ops): I'll update onboarding checklist and partner contract template. Action items: Jordan to add clause to contract template; Ben to produce final legal wording; Marta to implement SKU parser and UI badge; Priya to update listing UX. Deadline EOD Friday?
Ben (Legal): I can have final wording by Thursday COB.
Jordan (Partner Ops): I'll post updated checklist by Friday morning. :thumbsup:
Marta L: I'll prototype SKU parser mapping and badge by Friday — will need sample model names to test. @Alex K can you drop 3 sample partner models here?
Alex K: Dropping samples:
- "lumen-7b" upstream (Apache 2.0)
- "orchid-13b-quant" forked by SI (BSD-3)
- "stella-3b-priv" upstream (custom license, export flag: restricted)
Marta L: Perfect, thanks.
Priya: Small UX note: show reason for block and a contact link to partner ops.
Ben (Legal): Also recommend we add a short machine-readable license field in the manifest (SPDX id) so automated checks can decide fast.
Alex K: OK team — consensus and next steps logged. I'll follow up in partner onboarding ticket with links to the clause and SKU spec. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
Marketplace Bot: Note saved to partnership-ticket-9142 by Jordan (Partner Ops) at 2976543360.
